context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 49 verified all P1 features. Key findings: 1) Story Editor: Opens from feed page story circle, has 4 tools (Texto, Sticker, Fondo, Encuesta), text panel has input/font/bold/italic/align/size/color controls, sticker panel shows SVG grid, background panel has 10 gradients, poll panel has question/options inputs, publish panel has caption/visibility/publish button. 2) Profile page: Default tab is Reels (not Posts), Albums tab shows album cards with public/private badges (Globe/Shield icons), photo count, and Gestionar button that navigates to /albums. 3) Backend: GET /api/albums returns user albums, POST /api/stories/ creates stories with overlays metadata, mobile JWT has 365-day expiry.
